events.text_en: The founder of Ngạo Tuyết Phái hunts the tiger of Thạch Khẩu to Hổ Khiếu Cương and kills it, a month after it killed his daughter.
Ngạo Tuyết Phái moves its sword hall into the empty ore town of Thạch Khẩu Trấn; the plum garden above Hàn Mai becomes its gate.
A Hàn Mai boy follows a wandering sword sage into the mountains for three winters and comes home with a sword.
